Delicious Northern Vietnamese cuisine in Saigon continues to satisfy
Nov 2024 • Friends
This was my second visit to this Northern Vietnamese cuisine restaurant. This time a lunch catch up with a local friend.

Aside from the entree pork dish, our hotpot dish was full of food sourced in and around rivers …. the large river snails were amazing! My first taste and definitely not my last.

The service is super friendly, which just makes you want to stay and keep on ordering. The lovely service and the yummy food is definitely a wining combination. I know I will be back for a third time.

Western tourists: please don’t be intimidated by the Vietnamese menu, just ask for an English menu. They are more than happy to bring one out.

Traditional Vietnamese dishes delight!
Sep 2024 • Couples
My partner and I came here for dinner tonight. We ordered their signature brand dish the Bun Dau Man Tom Mixed Combo consisting of a fresh herbs vermicelli, sliced pork and sausages, and extra fried tofu served with marjoram, perilla, cucumber and shrimp paste stirred with kumquat, sugar and hot fat! Yes it was simply delicious. 

We had with this a Chau Muc Dai Duong a very special fried squid dish… we finished it off with the delicious Dau Homemade special dessert made with soya bean pudding, lychees and soy milk. 

The service was super friendly and they provided me with an English version of the menu too, by that stage my Vietnamese partner had already selected our dinner and what a great selection.
